programme.title: Complete Silver Set
programme.desc: Celebrate 250 years of American freedom with this Complete Collection of 50 Proof Sets in their original government packaging. This monumental collection contains over 400 iconic American Proof coins from 1970 to 2020, as the pinnacle of US coinage!

programme.title: Rare 1800's Silver
programme.desc: Add the stunning 1882 to 1884 Carson City Morgan Silver Dollars that come in brilliant uncirculated condition! Morgans struck at the CC Mint are among the most highly sought after by numismatists due to their low mintages & limited availability.

programme.title: Rare Diamond Silver
programme.desc: Own the FIRST EVER Set of Diamond Field Finish coins, specifically designed for America's 250th Anniversary and never before seen on any other coin! These Diamond Finish 1776-2026 Morgan & Peace Silver Dollars can be yours in PF69 or PF70 condition.

programme.title: Silver Legendary Coin Icon Set
programme.desc: Add this epic set of 4 2021 American Silver Eagles, graded in perfect Proof 70 condition to your numismatic collection. Each of these American Silver Eagles rank among the rarest in the series and come signed by the engraver that sculpted the design!

programme.title: 1776 Rare USA Silver
programme.desc: Celebrate the 250th Anniversary of the USA with the limited edition dual date 1776-2026 Liberty Bell Privy Silver Eagle graded PF70UCAM in a Ronald Reagan holder. Limited to just 500,000 examples, this is a one of a kind rarity!

programme.title: Silver Historic Rarity Coin Set
programme.desc: Secure a complete 2025 Set of the iconic Morgan and Peace Silver Dollars, struck from .999 pure silver! This set contains 2 of each coin in Mint State, Proof, and Reverse Proof 70 condition with each mintage among the lowest of the modern series!

programme.title: Historic Silver Set
programme.desc: Add the Set of 2 2021 Type 1 & Type 2 American Silver Eagles graded in perfect Proof 70 Ultra Cameo condition to your numismatic collection. These coins mark the end of an era and are two of the most significant coins produced in the entire series.

programme.title: Rare Diamond Silver
programme.desc: Own the FIRST EVER Set of Diamond Field Finish coins, specifically designed for America's 250th Anniversary and never before seen on any other coin! These Diamond Finish 1776-2026 Morgan & Peace Silver Dollars can be yours in PF69 or PF70 condition.

programme.title: Silver 1776 Rarity
programme.desc: Collect the very first Enhanced Uncirculated Silver Eagle featuring the Landing Eagle reverse. This Enhanced Finish issue has a mintage 4 times lower than the 1776–2026 Proof issue and features a Liberty Bell privy mark celebrating America's 250th!
